{{KeyDescription}}

The tag {{Key|railway:signal:traversable}} is used to map markings on railway signals which indicate how to proceed in the case of a signal failure.

== How to map ==
The tag {{Tag|railway:signal:traversable}} should be added to the {{IconNode}} node of the main/minor signal to which it applies. Its value is the country-specific name of the respective marking.

An additional sub-tag {{Tag|railway:signal:traversable:type}} is used to desribe the behaviour prescribed by the marking in an internationally standardised way.

=== Country-specific values ===
* [[OpenRailwayMap/Tagging in Germany#Post Plates|Germany]] (+ tram signal [[OpenRailwayMap/Tagging Trams in Germany#So 4|So 4]])
* [[OpenRailwayMap/Tagging in Luxembourg#RF7|Luxembourg]]
* [[OpenRailwayMap/Tagging in France#Sémaphore|France]]
* …

=== Traversable types ===
The following table presents possible values for the {{Tag|railway:signal:traversable:type}} key. When applicable, several values may be used and separated using a semicolon. For common combinations see [https://taginfo.openstreetmap.org/keys/railway:signal:traversable:type#values taginfo].

{| class="wikitable"
|-
! Value
! Description
|-
| {{TagValue|railway:signal:traversable:type|no}}
| Trains may never pass a signal being defect or showing red.
|-
| {{TagValue|railway:signal:traversable:type|written_default_speed}}
| Trains may proceed with default speed (reduced speed if there are switches behind the signal) if they have a written command.
|-
| {{TagValue|railway:signal:traversable:type|written_on_sight}}
| Trains may proceed on sight if they have a written command.
|-
| {{TagValue|railway:signal:traversable:type|dictated_default_speed}}
| Trains may proceed with default speed (reduced speed if there are switches behind the signal) if they have a command which has been dictated via phone or radio.
|-
| {{TagValue|railway:signal:traversable:type|dictated_on_sight}}
| Trains may proceed on sight if they have a command which has been dictated via phone or radio.
|-
| {{TagValue|railway:signal:traversable:type|oral_default_speed}}
| Trains may proceed with default speed (reduced speed if there are switches behind the signal) if they get an oral permission (spoken out, via phone or via radio).
|-
| {{TagValue|railway:signal:traversable:type|oral_on_sight}}
| Trains may proceed on sight if they get an oral permission (spoken out, via phone or via radio).
|-
| {{TagValue|railway:signal:traversable:type|on_no_contact_on_sight}}
| Trains may proceed on sight if the cannot establish a connection with the signal box via phone or radio.
|-
| {{TagValue|railway:signal:traversable:type|always_on_sight}}
| Trains may proceed on sight. A permission is not necessary.
|}
